blocks.text: Grankee Seamless Sport Thong - The best sport and daily use thongs!

Why should you chose our thongs?
✅ COMFORT - Super soft fabric that moves with you for superior comfort.
High waist supportive wide compression waistband provide best tummy control, under belly button.
✅ COLOURFUL - Available in various colorful designs and comes in XS-XL
✅ Moisture Wicking, never awkward during workout, durable, easy wash and easy dry.
✅quality product lets the customer be happy.
✅Fabric friendly.

Notice:
Hand wash or machine wash cold.
Wash with similar colors only
Do not bleach.
Tumble dry low

items: 【TRUE HIGH WAIST】Supportive wide compression waistband provide best tummy control,under belly button. Special design as yoga and workout undies .
【SUPER SOFT】Ultra stretchy seamless panty thong with cotton liner,tag free comfort.Body material: 92% Nylon （polyamide）+ 8% Spandex; liner material: 95% cotton + 5% Spandex.
【MOISTURE WICKING】Wicks away moisture to keep you dry -Light up your sport! Never awkward!

items.label: 【MEASUREMENTS】Hip XS
items.value: 36-38"; S: 38-40"; M: 40-42.5"; L: 43-45"; XL: 45-47". Waist XS (21.5") S (23.5") M (25.5") L (27.5") XL (29.1"), It is a flat measurement, please measure your waist under the navel.
